description: Carried forward from iteration 1 (previously FIND-010), still unresolved: there is no SKILL.md (or equivalent onboarding doc) for skills/earn/pm-trade/, unlike sibling earn slots. The model driving the ReAct loop still has no documented interface telling it that momentum.py/lib.py/decide.py exist, what units they expect, or how the pass is invoked -- this gap is now more pronounced than iteration 1 since the slot has grown from 4 files to 8 (lib.py, momentum.py, gate.py, decide.py plus their tests and run.sh) with no onboarding doc added to match.
